ayan: Quick shoutout to Riley, Keisha, and Facilities for the lunchtime demo rescue — projector died and they MacGyvered audio-only slides so the customer call stayed calm. huge thanks :raised_hands: :sparkles:

riley: team scramble but we got it. Keisha ran slide timing and I rerouted the HDMI to the backup laptop. shoutout to @facilities for the miracle multi-adapter.

keisha: also big thanks to Marc who ran the remote checklist and kept the Q&A civil when video dropped. tiny victories. :clap: (reactions: :tada: x3)

marc: happy to help. extra thanks to whoever left the oatmeal raisin cookies in the kitchen  snack hero moment :cookie:

facilities: glad it worked out! we'll label the backup adapters and leave a note on the AV bag. also please remind teams the big room has a scheduled maintenance this Friday 9am.

tacoBot: Poll: "Thank-you treat for Facilities & Riley/Keisha"  React: 1️⃣ Donut box, 2️⃣ Sandwich tray, 3️⃣ Cookie assortment. Poll open 12h.

ayan: voting 3️⃣ cookies. sweet thanks.

riley: 2️⃣ sandwiches so folks have protein.

keisha: 1️⃣ donuts for morale.

ayan: I'll drop a kudos card after lunch and pick up the winner. tiny gestures, big gratitude. :heart:
